FEAT-5-S151.title: Allowlist Configuration Management
FEAT-5-S151.description: Define and implement a centralized allowlist configuration for permitted tools, including mapping between tool names, handlers, and associated Pydantic models used by the tool_router.

FEAT-5-S152.title: Standardized Error Handling for Tool Rejection
FEAT-5-S152.description: Implement consistent error responses for non-allowlisted tools and validation failures, including structured error payloads returned to the agent loop and safe user-facing messaging.

FEAT-5-S153.title: Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging
FEAT-5-S153.description: Integrate debug logging into tool routing flow to capture tool selection, allowlist decisions, validation outcomes, and execution timing for traceability and QA analysis.

FEAT-5-S154.title: Security Guardrails for Unauthorized Tool Invocation
FEAT-5-S154.description: Enforce strict blocking of any tool invocation not present in the allowlist, including defensive handling of malformed or adversarial tool_use payloads to prevent unintended execution paths.
